title: Global Average Treatment Effect Minimax Risk on Random Regular Graphs: A Collision-Discrepancy Approach
banked_reason: No concrete route remains for the dense-range operator bound after the Xu/Charlier construction failed its trace-order and projection requirements and the independent switching-variance premise was disproved by an admissible regular-graph family.
gap_reasons: Xu 2025 Sections 2.2--2.3 is single-shape/absolute-value, cannot retain cross-Charlier cancellation, proposed trace order violates its hypothesis, and PHP misses the right-projection row-sum term.

Explicit disjoint projective-plane incidence graphs in the admissible dense range disprove the graphwise conditional quadratic-variation estimate C4 by lower bound 2d^2/(3m) versus proposed upper bound 2Cd.
proof_attempt_summary: The retry passed the field-novelty proposal gate and proved reusable simple-completion factorial moments through m <= 2K+2 together with an n^2 E(B_12-Q_12)^2 <= n^(-18+o(1)) Boolean truncation bound. The grouped Charlier/Xu route failed because its cancellation, trace-order, and full right-projection requirements do not fit the cited theorem; an independent switching-discrepancy route then failed when its graphwise variance premise was disproved by an admissible regular-graph family. The typical uniform-random-regular claim is not refuted, but closing the dense-range operator bound now requires genuinely new concentration input.
tldr: The full matched minimax frontier is not established in this round. The inherited unrestricted lower edge, seed upper certificate, finite compiler, sparse Boolean operator theorem, and dense Boolean-polynomial truncation remain valid. The newly prescribed collision-discrepancy route fails at its sole new premise: an explicit admissible sequence of disjoint projective-plane incidence graphs disproves the proposed graphwise conditional two-switch variance bound. This does not refute the desired high-probability Boolean operator theorem for a uniform random regular graph, but it means that a typical-graph refinement or a genuinely different concentration argument is still required. Consequently the archived logarithmic risk bracket, not \(R_2(G_n)\asymp d_n^2/[n\log(d_n+1)]\), remains the unconditional conclusion.
gap: Kandiros--Harshaw--S\'{a}vje, Corollary 5.4, studies the identical \(q=2\) GATE minimax game and leaves \(d_n/n\lesssim R_2(G_n)\lesssim d_n^2/n\). The archived \texttt{exp\_randomregular\_fullgate\_minimax\_frontier\_v1} derivation supplies, as inherited infrastructure, the sharper all-procedure lower edge \(d_n^2/[n\log(d_n+1)]\), the seed-design upper certificate of order \(d_n^2/n\), and a total exhaustive compiler, but it leaves a logarithmic gap.
fill: The paper audits and reuses the inherited balanced converse, seed construction, and finite compiler; proves the separate sparse-range supporting estimate; and concentrates its sole new root-level obligation in a signed four-root completion-switching bound. That bound, the bookkeeping trace identity, and the inherited ingredients yield the matching upper and lower edges uniformly over every admissible degree sequence.
